what: The text is left transparent and drawn with two shadow copies (in place · 6em below). On hover both shadows rise together, so the in-place text exits upward while the lower copy rises in with the accent color (.3s) — a roll without writing the text twice. Applied to a whole card or list row, the text lines inside roll together.

options.--fx-roll-hover: Color of the rising text, default --kf-accent (for the white-text type, both use --kf-on-accent)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Inline text run. Required — for single-line text
options.--fx-roll-gap: Distance between the two sets, default 6em — it must be larger than the line height for the second set to hide (one project 1.5em · line height 1)

note: The text color is transparent so the selection is not visible when picking — same as the original. Don’t use it on text that wraps to two lines (the second line’s shadow rises onto the first)

from.where: .ns-roll·.ns-card__title on all pages (card titles · list rows · location indicators)
shared.css .lw-roll (bracket button · black pill text) — two copies of the same color at 1.5em spacing, .3s ease: --fx-roll-gap: 1.5em; --fx-ease: ease; --fx-roll-hover: var(--kf-ink)
shared.css .sz-roll (header menu·button·card text — original text-shadow moved 1lh up over .3s ease, the incoming text has the same color)

shared.css .tg-button__inner (pill button·one-page summary button) — original c-button text line moves up 1.5em with text-shadow 0 1.5em 0 in .4s (var(--transition)) ease, background brown→yellow, text white→brown
